answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Lattice. Each agent identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from a public randomness beacon, and the response is consumed on submission—validators record its digest so a replay returns umber-flagged as duplicate. To pass, an attacker must solve each challenge independently per identity, paying full compute cost every time with no reuse across sybils. A shared pool cannot amortize work; every forged identity needs its own nectar of solved work. The beacon also seeds a nebula of rotating parameters, so precomputation expires quickly.
